message:
Vulkan paged weight allocator (#7167)

Support Vulkan weight paging to reduce GPU memory usage when running large models on memory-constrained devices.

- Add tiered weight storage across device memory, host memory, and disk-backed temporary files, with configurable memory limits.
- Support host-visible Vulkan buffers and CPU memory fallback for host-resident weights.
- Upload non-device-resident weights into temporary GPU buffers on demand during inference.
- Overlap weight uploads with compute execution using separate command buffers and queue synchronization.
- Manage temporary weight buffers per command to support concurrent extractors and external Vulkan commands.
- Add cross-platform temporary file handling, memory-mapped weight storage, and automatic cleanup.
- Add configuration APIs, developer documentation, correctness tests, and performance benchmarks.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
